name: Animate Objects
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Lore. Choose up to ten mundane objects within long range, with a combined weight in pounds no greater than ten times the roll result. Each chosen object becomes an animated construct creature for the duration of the spell.

While the spell persists, you may spend a half action to issue a simple command to any number of these constructs. Each construct follows its most recent command to the best of its ability, spending its one action each turn and flying up to 30 ft in any direction as needed. Each construct continues to act until it is destroyed, receives a new command, or the spell ends.

Describe the objects and how you command them.
successes:
✨: You may add WITS to the objects' damage rolls.

✨: When you enter engagement, each of your animated objects that is adjacent to you may spend a reaction to grant you a single-use d4 engagement die for the engagement.

🌞: You may animate an additional group of up to five objects, and the total weight limit for objects you can animate increases by half.

💀: Some of the objects (1d4 of them, chosen at random) turn against you. They immediately move to be adjacent to you and make their melee attacks against you, then the spell ends. Check a Condition.
